title: ULPIN (Bhu-Aadhaar) Coverage Crosses 95% Nationally — 13.5 Crore Parcels Geo-Coded
summary: Department of Land Resources confirms 28 states have achieved over 90% ULPIN seeding, with nationwide geo-coded parcel coverage at an all-time high.

title: e-Courts Integration with Land Records Goes Live Across 18 States
summary: Civil Court stay orders and Lis Pendens will now automatically reflect in RoR within 24 hours of court filing through the National Judicial Data Grid.

title: Rajasthan Completes Drone-Based Cadastral Re-Survey in 6 Districts
summary: Survey of India deploys high-resolution LiDAR drones in Udaipur, Ajmer, and 4 other districts to resolve agricultural boundary ambiguities under SVAMITVA.

title: CERSAI Linkage Mandatory for All Land-Backed Loans — Double-Mortgage Fraud Drops 62%
summary: All scheduled commercial banks now verify parcel ULPIN status through CERSAI before sanctioning agricultural or commercial credit against land.

title: Maharashtra Achieves 100% Digital Mutation — Paper-Free e-Ferfar Statewide
summary: Maharashtra becomes the first state to process all mutation applications digitally with guaranteed 15-day turnaround under Right to Public Services.

title: Land Stack Platform Supports 12 Indian Languages for RoR Downloads
summary: Citizens can now download officially verified translated RoR extracts in Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali, Gujarati, Odia, Punjabi, Malayalam, Assamese, and English.

title: DoLR Launches National State Comparison Dashboard for DILRMP Progress
summary: A new national comparison dashboard enables real-time tracking of cadastral digitization, RoR-map integration, and mutation pendency across all 36 states and UTs.

title: Tribal Land Protection Alert System Deployed in 12 States Under Forest Rights Act
summary: Automated lock prevents unauthorized mutation entry on protected tribal and forest holdings without explicit District Collector approval in 12 tribal-majority states.
